steps.think: That's a milestone for them. I'll count orders by status to see how many shipped.

input.command: psql shop -c "select status, count(*) from orders group by status order by 2 desc"

steps.result:
status  | count
----------+-------
 shipped  |   912
 paid     |    61
 placed   |    27
(3 rows)

steps.say: Congrats on 1,000 orders! 912 of them have shipped. Another 61 are paid and waiting to go out, and 27 were placed in the last day, so nothing is stuck.
